mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

anchorSignBytes.note: v1 is the pre-v3.2.2 anchor message. v2 is in force from the chain's rdk-integrity feature (diana height 6905034, mainnet 3556788). Both vectors were generated by calling the chain's own x/multilayer/types.AnchorSignBytes functions, not by reimplementing them.

mldsaVector.note: Generated by @qorechain/sdk pqcSign; independently verified by @noble/post-quantum ml_dsa87 (FIPS-204). Every language client must verify(publicKeyHex, messageUtf8 bytes, signatureHex) === true.

transitionRoot.source: generated by calling the chain's own BatchTransitionRoot, WithdrawalLeaf and WithdrawalLeafV2 at release v3.2.5

withdrawalTree.source: every proof is accepted by the chain's own VerifyWithdrawalMerkle at release v3.2.5, and refused at the wrong index; leaf position = withdrawal index, nodes SHAKE-256(left || right), an odd last node is paired with itself

daBlob.source: the chain's blob commitment, qorehash.Sum256 (SHAKE-256, 32 bytes)

hybridTx.source: built by @qorechain/sdk buildHybridTx (TypeScript), which the chain accepts; ML-DSA-87 signing is deterministic, so every client must produce these exact bytes. Signer: the golden mnemonic; post-quantum key: the canonical derivation shake256("qorechain:pqc:v1|" + nativeAddress + "|" + mnemonic).
